`if (issued_on.year, issued_on.month) != (year, month)` replaces the string prefix, and the row writes `issued_on.isoformat()`. Function signatures unchanged.

Malformed dates raise instead of being skipped: `skipped` is a business rule for unsupported countries, and silently dropping bad rows would quietly lose revenue.

## Tests (`tests/test_export.py`)
- `test_export_month_renders_issued_on_as_iso_date` — parametrized over the four accepted shapes, each also asserting neighbouring months (`2026-09-30`, `2026-11-01`) are excluded.
- `test_export_month_rejects_issued_on_that_is_not_a_date` — pins the `ValueError` and message.
